723: We're dedicating this year's first camp to a restart after the COVID wave and getting ready for a year full of riding. The season is here, and with it the time to train technique on everything we may encounter on a ride, off-road and on. Pump track, trails, berms, corners, brake control, balance, and also awareness of the bike itself. All in a one-day course for women.
724: The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something. The technical trail will help us practise handling berms, rock gardens, sharp corners and other features you may come across off-road.
725: On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have small jumps ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast.
726: There are also Trial obstacles – in other words, what to avoid and what to try riding over on a ride.
